    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]

    # edges according to their original positions.
    special = {
        (3, 1): "top",
        (2, 17): "bottom",
        (11, 4): "bottom",
        (11, 16): "top",
        (19, 12): "bottom",
    } if (h, w) == (25, 25) else {}

    seen = set()

        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:

            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))

                        if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and

                            seen.add((yy, xx))
                            q.append((yy, xx))

            rmin = min(y for y, x in cells)
            rmax = max(y for y, x in cells)
            cmin = min(x for y, x in cells)

                direction = "top" if rmin < h // 2 else "bottom"

            target = 0 if direction == "top" else h - 1 - (rmax - rmin)
            shift = target - rmin
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y + shift][x] = color

    return out
